decision.weights_validation_note: Phase 7: Spearman(decision score, realized ROI) = 0.0015 on EPL 2022-26 walk-forward (n=1520). The 7-component score does NOT rank profitable bets; tercile ROI is non-monotonic and negative at every tercile. Weights are an unvalidated prior. Betting decisions are gated by edge/EV/sample/CI/CLV (Phases 3/4/6), not by this score.

signal_engine.weights_validation_note: Initial configurable prior (spec S17), NOT statistically optimal. Calibrate via backtest before trusting. P3: data_quality weight kept at 0.05 by design -- cross-source odds disagreement (and thin completeness) is enforced as an explicit completeness DOCK (eff_completeness = 0.5x on disagreement) plus a MEDIUM confidence cap plus an explicit reason, not by inflating the weight; a larger weight would only scale an unvalidated prior. The disagreement path is thus visible and confidence-relevant without re-weighting on no evidence.

tie_state_penalties._note: K3 2026-08-28: soft score multipliers from context_data.tie_state (leg-2 detected from H2H). Decided tie (agg margin >= 2): picks needing the LEADER to win 90' x0.85. Balanced tie: Over / BTTS Yes x0.92. Measured via failure_class K3 before becoming a veto.

signal_engine.movement_confidence_note: Layer 4: movement is 1 of 7 evidence components (weight 0.15); an opposing market move does not by itself cap confidence â€” model (0.30) + statistical (0.20) + market edge (0.20) can still produce HIGH. Documented prior, not a hidden inconsistency.
